verdict.rationale: Datadog has a first-party 'OpenTelemetry in Datadog' documentation page, and a customer reports instrumenting Elixir apps with OTel and sending the data to Datadog. That points to vendor-neutral, open-standard instrumentation that would make switching backends possible. The pack only gives the page title, though, so the depth of OTel support and how portable it really is cannot be confirmed. missing for 10: documented detail on native OTLP ingestion (Collector/Agent), confirmation that Datadog features work with OTel-only instrumentation without proprietary SDKs, and evidence of actually switching backends without re-instrumenting.

support.subject: As an SRE, I can instrument once with open standards and switch backends without re-instrumenting my code

citations.quote: Had to use OTel for Elixir apps since there's no DD SDK for Elixir/Erlang.
